name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Setup npmrc
        run: echo "//npm.pkg.github.com/:_authToken=${{secrets.NPM_AUTH_TOKEN}}" > .npmrc

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: npm ci
